facts.fact: Nobus Cloud Services, run by Nkponani Limited from Lagos, is a public cloud provider whose platform is established in Nigeria and hosts workloads for businesses, enterprises and government institutions; the document names no facility and gives no opening date, so the date is the article's publication date (2026-09-09).

note: Nigerian providers Galaxy, Suburban, Layer3, Nebula named only as a cohort; Nairobi zone is Kenya; AWS naira payments are not a region.
